title: Observability: unhandled wolfCrypt error codes silently become -EIO
description: All four xlat_err functions (wolfssl_cbc_xlat_err, wolfssl_gcm_xlat_err, wolfssl_hmac_xlat_err, wolfssl_sha_xlat_err, wolfssl_cmac_xlat_err) send unrecognized wc_err codes to pr_debug_ratelimited then return -EIO. In production, pr_debug is not emitted unless dyndbg is explicitly enabled. A support engineer handed a -EIO return and no ring buffer message cannot determine which wolfCrypt error occurred — the raw error code is permanently lost. The debug log should be pr_err_ratelimited, or the wc_err must be included in the caller-level log. Affected default: branches in wolfssl_aes_cbc.c:66, wolfssl_aes_gcm.c:78, wolfssl_hmac.c:43, wolfssl_sha.c:69, wolfssl_cmac.c:43.
